about: A tool that evens out the loudness of audio and video files.

prs.title: Files fixed in place keep their permissions
prs.broken: Normalizing a file in place left it readable only by its owner, so media servers and shared folders could no longer open it.
prs.changed: The new file now gets the same permissions as the original.
prs.matters: People can normalize a music library in place without breaking their media server.

prs.title: FLAC files keep their cover art
prs.broken: Normalizing the volume of a FLAC song threw away its album cover, with a warning that FLAC cannot hold pictures, which is not true.
prs.changed: Cover pictures are now kept when the output is FLAC. Real video tracks are still left out, as before.
prs.matters: Music libraries keep their album art after normalizing.
